data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492 reported a net prior year release of GBP 26.741 million for 2022. This was primarily driven by a GBP 27.065 million profit attributable to the 2021 underwriting year of account. This was partially offset by a GBP 0.324 million loss attributable to the 2020 and prior years of account, which included the impact of a legacy transaction (Loss Portfolio Transfer) with Enstar syndicate 2008 for the 2018 and prior years. This LPT, which had a net cost of GBP 2.122 million, transferred claims handling obligations and aimed to mitigate the impact of inflation on prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: legacy transaction with Enstar syndicate 2008 (Enstar) for the 2018 & prior years of account. This provides us with a significant capital benefit as the business grows and transfers claims handling obligations to Enstar, thereby freeing up resources to concentrate on more recent years. The deal also mitigated the impact of the current level of inflation on prior year reserves.

The profits / losses arising from the 2021 and 2020 & prior years of account, in their second and third years of development respectively, result from underwriting and investment activities with little administrative and operating expense impact.

the NCOR analysis for 2022 (adjusted for LPT) excludes the impact of the 2018 & prior Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) for both premium and claims and instead includes the net cost of GBP 2,122,000 of that transaction as its own individual component.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance and includes the impact of a Loss Portfolio Transfer for 2018 & prior years, as derived from the profit attribution by underwriting year. A gross claims development triangle is present but its movements for 2018 & prior years appear inconsistent with a claims transfer (LPT) that should reduce gross liabilities, suggesting potential distortion or complex accounting treatment.
